==== model: The Zero-Summed Splitter ====

$likelihood
Dv ~ dlnorm(mu, sigma)

$main_model
mu <- loga[Mg] + gamma * (Mo - 1) + loc_eff * sigma_loc + yr[Yr] + 
    tr[Tr] * sigma_tr

$gamma_def
gamma <- s_conv + gap_shift * (Mg - 1)

$sigma_def
sigma <- exp(ls0 + ls_Mg * (Mg - 1) + ls_Mo * (Mo - 1) + ls_MgMo * 
    (Mg - 1) * (Mo - 1))

$prior_loga
loga[Mg] ~ dnorm(5, 2)

$prior_s
s_conv ~ dnorm(0, 1)

$prior_gs
gap_shift ~ dnorm(0, 1)

$prior_yr
yr[Yr] ~ dnorm(0, 1)

$prior_tr
tr[Tr] ~ dnorm(0, 1)

$prior_ls0
ls0 ~ dnorm(0, 0.5)

$prior_ls_Mg
ls_Mg ~ dnorm(0, 0.5)

$prior_ls_Mo
ls_Mo ~ dnorm(0, 0.5)

$prior_ls_MgMo
ls_MgMo ~ dnorm(0, 0.5)

$pr_sigma_loc
sigma_loc ~ dexp(2)

$pr_sigma_tr
sigma_tr ~ dexp(2)

$loc_eff_def
loc_eff <- b1 * (Lo == 1) + b2 * (Lo == 2) + b3 * (Lo == 3) - 
    (b1 + b2 + b3) * (Lo == 4)

$prior_b1
b1 ~ dnorm(0, 1)

$prior_b2
b2 ~ dnorm(0, 1)

$prior_b3
b3 ~ dnorm(0, 1)
